records.text: Hyun-bo Son was accused of violating South Korea’s Public Official Election Act and Local Education Autonomy Act after political remarks at a Christian protest.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: he was accused of violating the Public Official Election Act and the Local Education Autonomy Act... The conservative pastor participated in a protest... he shouted the words that Lee Jae-myung has to die for Korea to live.

verification.notes: Reporting confirms that Son was accused under the Public Official Election Act and Local Education Autonomy Act over political statements associated with church activity and a protest. Later reporting says he was convicted; the sources used are advocacy-oriented, so confidence is medium rather than high.
